subject.title: [Feature]: Open bot-inclusive Slack group DMs from App Home

question: Should the bundled Slack plugin add the App Home flow that opens or resumes bot-inclusive MPIMs, or should OpenClaw keep this as documented workaround guidance for now?
rationale: Current main does not implement the requested flow, and the change would add user-triggered Slack conversation creation plus starter-message behavior that needs maintainer-owned product and authorization direction.

options.title: Review bounded App Home opener
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102069 as the implementation candidate, requiring live Slack create/reopen proof and authorization review before merge.

options.title: Keep docs/workarounds only
options.body: Close or retarget the implementation PR and leave users with private-channel conversion or external conversations.open guidance.

options.title: Defer for broader interactivity design
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers decide whether App Home/interactivity creation flows need a reusable Slack control architecture first.

recommendation.title: Review bounded App Home opener
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102069 as the implementation candidate, requiring live Slack create/reopen proof and authorization review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision most directly extends the Slack App Home surface introduced in PR 73389.
